As it turns out, the Seahawks decided not to sign veteran running back Joe Mixon to their practice squad after he underwent a physical for the team, per league source. Mixon will remain a free agent. https://t.co/0blouVwvPU
#Ravens TE Durham Smythe suffered a torn Achilles on Sunday and he’s out for the season, the MRI confirmed. Unfortunately, exactly what it appeared Sunday. https://t.co/yDHQ4IJXUz
More about Arizona Cardinals starting left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. being out for the season after tearing his left biceps in a 36-24 loss to the Giants on Sunday. https://t.co/8wrFMJV9ls

Tampa Bay Rays hitters had the lowest strikeout rate in MLB this year. And against Cam Schlittler, who's winning the American League Cy Young, they punched out just two times -- the lowest total in any of Schlittler's 35 starts this season. Schlittler is done. Yankees trail, 3-1.
Falcons now have ruled out Za'Darius Smith with a concussion.
#Falcons LT Jake Matthews, one of the game’s true iron men, has a groin injury and is questionable to return. This is his 200th start and he hasn’t missed a game since 2014.
A big loss: Cardinals HC Mike LaFleur said LT Paris Johnson Jr. tore his bicep and now will be out for the season. https://t.co/7dFzNSnYWN
Source after the MRI: Expected to be out 2-3 weeks with a bone bruise. All in all, good news. https://t.co/OSfccEKgkL

From @GMFB: #Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton is out indefinitely with a dislocated ankle, while WR Rashee Rice tweaked his hamstring and will use the bye to recover. But what does it mean about a Tyreek Hill reunion? https://t.co/a5IUP735Br

FINAL: Braves 3, Dodgers 2 Ray Kerr opened for 2.2 and held Los Angeles scoreless. Robert Suarez was nails. Didier Fuentes retired 11 straight before allowing a homer. Raisel Iglesias got one out to end the game. Atlanta heads home with a split. Huge win. Sale vs. Yamamoto next.

#Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton suffered a dislocated ankle that was put back into place by doctors earlier today. He did make the plane with the team. Thornton will have a full evaluation in the morning, along with a second opinion. Out indefinitely, but in good spirits. https://t.co/DBvRHI3jeJ
